parameters: The great gate of Castle Nova is shut.
Only those summoned by the crown may pass.
\C[6]Gate Captain:\C[0]
Halt! The castle is closed by royal decree.
Petitions are heard at the Royal Gazette in the plaza.
\C[6]Gate Guard:\C[0]
The King has not held court since the Ashveil affair.
...I said nothing. You heard nothing.
The stable boy waves: "Mind the dung!"
\C[6]Soldier:\C[0]
One-two! One-two! ...Sorry, can't talk. Drill.
\C[6]Soldier:\C[0]
The Drill Sergeant can hear a yawn from fifty paces.
\C[6]Drill Sergeant:\C[0]
Shields UP! Swords DOWN! Feet APART!
You there - fancy a round in the yard? Come back when you're stronger.
\C[6]Barracks Archer:\C[0]
Diana of the Silent Hawk trained here once.
Never missed. Not once.
\C[6]Quartermaster:\C[0]
Rations, blankets and boots for three hundred men.
And nobody ever says thank you.
The warhorse tosses its mane proudly.
A grey mare nibbles at the hay.
\C[6]Stable Boy:\C[0]
Sir Roland's horse is the biggest one.
He calls it "Small".
\C[6]Knight:\C[0]
We ride to the northern border at dawn.
\C[6]Prison Guard:\C[0]
The Royal Prison. Visitors keep their hands
to themselves and their questions short.
\C[6]Prison Guard:\C[0]
Every rogue in Nova ends up behind this door
sooner or later. Some of them twice.
\C[6]ROYAL PRISON OF NOVA\C[0]
By order of the Crown. Visitors must report
to the Warden on entering.
\C[6]Soldier:\C[0]
Prison yard patrol. Twelve laps a watch.
Nobody has ever escaped. ...Nobody has ever tried.
